keepNumber.q: Can I keep my phone number?
keepNumber.a: Yes. Forward your existing number to Voicia, or use the number assigned to your assistant.

setupTime.a: Typically the same day. The Voicia team sets everything up with you.

replaceTeam.a: No. Voicia can transfer a call to a person, and writes a brief for every other call so your team can follow up.

extraMinutes.q: What happens after the included minutes?
extraMinutes.a: Calls keep being answered. Each extra minute is billed {first} on {firstPlan} and {second} on {secondPlan}, excl. VAT.
